page.layout: One printed page with running text in one column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the far left edge of the scan (partly cut off, belonging to the facing page). Running head at top centre; page number at top right.

p.i: optimatibus;sed alia iura non minus grania etiam concedenda sunt popularibus.
Opponitur huic statui respectu optimatum quidem,oligarchia, quando pauci aliquot rapiunt ad se imperium,respectu populi vero Ochlocratia,quando populus vult ad se rapere iura optimatum.

main_text.p: Atque haec etiam de statu temperato ex Aristocratia & Democratia: quae cum sit in plerisq; ciuitatibus,ideo diximus πολιτεία Politia vocatur, das Staatregiment, de quo plura vide in libro Lauterbacii,cui tit.est Regentenbuch / item in libello German.Pauli Negelini,cui tit.est,von bürgerlichem stand; item in libro Alberti Pulmanni,cui titul.est wie sich Amptragende in Ståten verhalten sollen;videatur etiam die policeyordnüg der Statt Nürnberg,item aliarum ciuitatum.
main_text.head: CAPVT VLTIMVM partis generalis, De statu temperato ex tribus formis simplicibus;& simul de statu mixto minus principali.
main_text.p: REstat status mixtus principalis tertius,qui nempe temperatur ex omnibus tribus formis;ex Monarchia, Aristocratia & Democratia. De quo statu sunt hi generales Canones:
1 Status hic plurimis locis & Rebuspub. valde est accommodatus,quia continet in se omnem Reipubl. formam, atque adeo omnis forma Reipubl. virtutes

page.notes: Marginal notes at left edge are cut off and only partly legible; not transcribed. Greek word in the text ("πολιτεία") approximated. The page number is printed as 585 at top right (read as "58j"). The head "CAPVT VLTIMVM" is a division heading; the caput number is not printed, so caput was set to 13 only by assumption and should be checked; the number may be omitted.
